name: HackerTarget API
tier_rationale: Small company with a long public record and published terms (A8 community): 'HackerTarget is a small company with a long public record: tier community.' (P014 rationale).

reliability.justification: Passive datasets (host search, reverse IP, DNS, ASN, analytics ids) from a small vendor: useful but incomplete and of unknown freshness; reverse-IP answers on shared hosting are counts only (P014 cond 6).

error_markers.reason: HackerTarget: daily quota exhausted (API count exceeded)
HackerTarget: request rejected (error check your search parameter)

hackertarget.description: HackerTarget API key (membership; sent as &apikey= only through the central redactor)
hackertarget.plan_hint: business = a company/team HackerTarget membership recorded by legal (key_plans.hackertarget, P014 cond 4); keyless use under corporate needs free_plan_business_use recorded from HackerTarget's free-tier terms

api.title: HackerTarget API (hostsearch, dnslookup, reversedns, reverseiplookup, aslookup, findshareddns, analyticslookup)

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal (key_plans.hackertarget). Keyless use under corporate needs legal to record free_plan_business_use=true from HackerTarget's free-tier terms (A1).

api.notes: Research C0012 terms 'HackerTarget free API terms' / 'HackerTarget ToS; free tier for light use' / 'HackerTarget terms (free tier, membership for more)'. Passive endpoints only, held in a code allow-list: hostsearch, reverseiplookup, aslookup, dnslookup, analyticslookup (P014 cond 1); never nmap, zonetransfer (P281 cond 5), mtr, httpheaders or pagelinks. hackertarget.com answers scripts with a 403, so the evidence page was not re-fetched on 2026-11-26. Used by hackertarget (analytics_ids pivots to it, P061 cond 4).

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G01-2, p2-G03-1 and p9-G13-2 (P014, P061, P281). Quota: '50/day per egress IP (budget <= 80%), shared by every module calling api.hackertarget.com' (P014 cond 3), observed through the x-api-quota/x-api-count headers (research C0012): budget 40/day; with a membership key the plan's own limit applies once recorded. Markers: 'API count exceeded' -> QUOTA (research sample 'API count exceeded - Increase Quota with Membership'; the provider is then exhausted for the day, P334 cond 8) and 'error check your search parameter' -> ERROR (P014 cond 2); the P014 batch ships the recorded fixtures and tests. 'no records found' is EMPTY at module level (never a marker). The key travels in the URL (&apikey=) only through the central redactor (AR01).
